individual-data-points.explanation: Scatter plot of rhythmicity index vs. period for individual samples; scatter plots are exempt as the points themselves are the individual data.
Scatter plot (each marker = one cell line/reporter mean with error bars); scatter plots are exempt from requiring an additional overlay of individual points.
Line/density plots of period and amplitude distributions; line plots are exempt from the individual-points requirement.
Box plots of ridge lengths already display the underlying individual sample points (Per2-Luc and Bmal1-Luc dots) overlaid on the boxes.
Polar histograms show distributions of phase differences per cell line, not a bar chart of a single averaged value needing an individual-points overlay.
Polar histogram of subtype-averaged phase differences; a distribution/histogram display, not a mean bar chart requiring point overlay.
Illustrative line trace of an example signal fit, not an averaged summary statistic requiring individual data points.
Scatter plot of individual samples (n = 117) with error bars reflecting fit uncertainty; scatter plots are exempt from the individual-points requirement.

error-bars-defined.Decision_and_explanation: PASS - error bars are defined in the caption as mean +/- standard deviation.

Extending whiskers represent data points within 1.5 times the interquartile range from lower and upper quartile. Median values are marked by red horizontal lines, and outliers by red crosses.
